subject: general
question: Who received the Arjuna Awards (Lifetime) for outstanding performance in Sports and Games 2024?

options.text: Shri Murlikant Rajaram Petkar and Shri Sucha Singh
Shri Harmanpreet Singh and Shri Praveen Kumar
Ms. Jyothi Yarraji and Ms. Annu Rani
Shri Gukesh D and Ms. Manu Bhaker

solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Murlikant Rajaram Petkar and Shri Sucha Singh**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arjuna Awards (Lifetime):** This award recognizes sportspersons who have shown outstanding performance and continue to contribute to the promotion of sports even after retirement.
 
• **Awardees for 2024:** Shri Murlikant Rajaram Petkar (Para-Swimming) and Shri Sucha Singh (Athletics).
 
• **Contribution of Shri Murlikant Rajaram Petkar:** India’s first Paralympic gold medalist and a pioneer in para-swimming.
 
• **Contribution of Shri Sucha Singh:** Known for his significant achievements in athletics and his dedication to training and mentoring young athletes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2024:**

 
 
• Awarded to Shri Gukesh D (Chess), Shri Harmanpreet Singh (Hockey), Shri Praveen Kumar (Para-Athletics), and Ms. Manu Bhaker (Shooting).
 
• This award is for the most outstanding performance over the previous four years.
 
 
 
• **Arjuna Awards 2024:**
 
 
• Awarded for consistent performance over four years and qualities of sportsmanship, leadership, and discipline.
 
• Key recipients include Ms. Jyothi Yarraji (Athletics) and Ms. Annu Rani (Athletics).
 
 
 
• **Dronacharya Award 2024:**
 
 
• Awarded to Shri Subhash Rana (Para-Shooting), Ms. Deepali Deshpande (Shooting), and Shri Sandeep Sangwan (Hockey) in the regular category.
 
• Lifetime category winners include Shri S. Muralidharan (Badminton) and Shri Armando Agnelo Colaco (Football).
 
 
 
• **Selection Committee:**
 
 
• The awards are recommended by a committee chaired by Justice (Retd.) V. Ramasubramanian.
 
• The committee includes eminent sportspersons, sports administrators, and sports journalists.
